bio.text: Jesse Vanderwende represents the 35th District in the Delaware House of Representatives, serving since 2018.
A Sussex County native born in 1987, Vanderwende is a farmer and businessman whose family farms in the Greenwood-Bridgeville area, and a co-owner of Vanderwende's Farm Fresh Ice Cream.
Vanderwende is a former president of the Delaware Soybean Board and of the Sussex County Farm Bureau.
Vanderwende graduated from Woodbridge High School and earned an associate degree in Agribusiness from Delaware Technical and Community College.
